name: convoy-monorepo
description: Convoy — Real-Time Road Trip Squad Navigator

scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix backend run start
scripts.serve: npm run build && npm --prefix backend run dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
